items.difficulty_reason: For an open immersion j : U -> X of Noetherian schemes, integers a <= b and an inverse system (K_n) in D^b_Coh(O_X) with H^i(K_n) = 0 outside [a, b], the lemma shows the equivalence of (K_n) being pro-isomorphic to a Deligne system and, for every p, the existence of a coherent O_X-module F such that the pro-systems (H^p(K_n)) and (I^n F) are pro-isomorphic (statement lines 8319-8355). Assuming the first, one may take (K_n) to be a Deligne system, so by definition there is a bounded complex F^bullet of coherent modules and an ideal cutting out X minus U with K_n represented by I^n F^bullet, and the result follows from Lemma labelled lemma-consequence-Artin-Rees-bis (proof lines 8337-8345). For the converse the proof inducts on b - a: for a = b the claim holds essentially by assumption, and for a < b it considers the compatible system of distinguished triangles tau_{<= a}K_n -> K_n -> tau_{>= a+1}K_n -> ... of Derived Categories, Remark labelled derived-remark-truncation-distinguished-triangle; the induction hypothesis makes the two outer systems pro-isomorphic to Deligne systems, and Lemma labelled lemma-deligne-system-2-out-of-3 concludes (proof lines 8347-8355). Reducing the general bounded case to the study of the individual cohomology sheaves by truncation and 2-out-of-3 is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
